digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift workflow and Gerrit CI gate
propositions: terraform-drift.yml workflow does not run on Gerrit changes because triggers are limited to pull_request, push to main, and schedule—Gerrit changes bypass both
unapplied terraform resources pass Verified +1 gate and land to main, then drift check fails post-merge exposing the infrastructure gap
the guard (CI gate) shares the change's assumption: Verified +1 silently does not prove infrastructure exists, only that code builds and tests pass
terraform changes require manual apply step after merge, but no pre-submit mechanism enforces that applied state before the change is submitted

either the drift check must run pre-submit (distinguishing the change's own new resources from previously-committed unapplied HCL), or an explicit apply attestation must be required to land terraform changes
